tools.name: plan_road_trip
tools.description: Plan a road trip by campervan or car between 2-10 places with the OpenVan.camp roadbook: distance, driving time and a day-by-day plan with overnights, budget (fuel, tolls, vignettes, ferries), and for every country on the way the entry rule for the given passports, residence permit and plates, how l

tools.name: get_country_travel_brief
tools.description: Everything to know before driving into one country by campervan or car, in one call: entry rule and how long the person and the vehicle may stay (with passport), travel weather now and this week, fuel prices, tolls and vignettes, public holidays in the next 30 days, safety advice, power plugs, custo

tools.name: get_roadbook_build_status
tools.description: Internal helper for the plan_road_trip card: progress of the roadbook build (route, tolls, borders and cities, campsites, weather, news). Not for direct use — call plan_road_trip.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Covers gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list. Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, LPG/autogas/propane or CNG in one country; without a co

tools.name: compare_fuel_prices
tools.description: Compare current prices for one fuel type across 2-10 countries. Returns sorted table cheapest-first. Use it when someone asks which of two or more named countries has cheaper or more expensive fuel.

tools.name: find_cheapest_fuel
tools.description: Rank countries by the price of a fuel type in a region (or worldwide): the cheapest first, or with order=most_expensive the most expensive first. Useful for route planning. Use it for «where is fuel cheapest» and, with order=most_expensive, «where is fuel the most expensive», in a region or worldwid

tools.name: get_country_travel_weather
tools.description: How suitable the weather in a whole country is for travelling and sleeping in a campervan, as a 0-100 score: overall travel score, sleep score, solar panel yield, driving conditions, awning safety, condensation risk, a 7-day forecast, and the 3 best and 3 toughest cities for the coming week. Country

tools.name: get_city_travel_weather
tools.description: How suitable the weather in one city or town is for travelling and sleeping in a campervan, as a 0-100 score for today and for the coming 7 days, with sleep, driving and solar scores and daily scores. Use this, not get_country_travel_weather, when the user names a place (Barcelona, Málaga, Alicante)

tools.name: list_best_weather_countries
tools.description: List the N countries where today's weather is best for travelling by campervan, highest 0-100 travel score first. Use it when no country is named and someone asks where to go for warm or good weather right now — worldwide or in a region (region=europe…); with sort=warmest only when they literally as

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List vanlife events: expos (Caravan Salon), festivals, meetups, forums, road trips. Filter by status, type, country, or free-text search.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details for a single vanlife event by its slug.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search recent news about campervans, motorhomes and road travel collected by OpenVan.camp from public news sources. Returns for each story only a headline, a short summary of up to 300 characters, date, category, countries and a link to the story page on openvan.camp, which credits the original publ

tools.name: compare_food_prices
tools.description: Compare food price index between two countries (world average = 100). Higher number = more expensive food. Use it when someone asks where food is cheaper between two countries.

tools.name: get_country_food_prices
tools.description: Food price index for one country (world average = 100): how expensive groceries are there, with its yearly history. Use it when someone asks how expensive food, groceries or living is in a country.

tools.name: rank_food_prices
tools.description: Rank countries by food price index (world average = 100) in a region or worldwide: the cheapest first, or with order=most_expensive the most expensive first. Use it when someone asks where food or groceries are cheapest or most expensive.

tools.name: get_currency_rate
tools.description: Convert an amount between two currencies using live rates (150+ currencies, daily updates). Use it for exchange rates and converting an amount between currencies.

tools.name: check_visa_rules
tools.description: Entry rules for one passport and destination: entry mode, allowed length of stay, how the days are counted (per entry or in a rolling window), whether a visa run resets the counter, and temporary vehicle import. Answers carry a confidence level and source — pass those on instead of stating a rule as

tools.name: get_route_visa_rules
tools.description: Visa rules for every country of a route in one call, for up to 10 passports at once, plus the tightest leg of the route.

tools.name: get_vehicle_import_rules
tools.description: Temporary admission rules for a foreign-plated vehicle in one country: allowed days, per entry or per window, carnet requirement, green card. A country without a rule we can stand behind returns nothing rather than a guess.

tools.name: get_toll_rates
tools.description: Toll reference for one country: payment system, per-km rates by vehicle class (car, campervan up to 3.5 t, over 3.5 t), vignette prices for every duration, concession sections and toll bridges/tunnels, each with verification date and source. Use it for toll roads, motorway fees, whether a vignette i

tools.name: estimate_route_tolls
tools.description: Estimate toll cost for a road trip from 2-10 place names: per-km tolls, vignettes, bridges and tunnels, as a EUR range with a per-country breakdown. Flags partial results when a country on the route has no data. Use it only for the toll cost between named places when no other trip details are asked;

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays, school holidays (often regional, with ISO 3166-2 region codes) and official peak traffic days (France, Bison Futé) in one country for a period of up to 400 days. A country without data returns an error saying so — never present that as "no holidays". Use it for public holidays, days

tools.name: get_travel_hazards
tools.description: Situation now in one country: UK FCDO travel advice level and current GDACS natural disasters (flood, earthquake, tropical cyclone, wildfire, drought, volcano) with alert level green/orange/red. Not a forecast. Use it when someone asks whether it is safe to go to a country now, about travel warnings

tools.name: get_active_fires
tools.description: NASA FIRMS VIIRS satellite fire detections of the last 48 hours in a bounding box up to 10°×10°, strongest first, with fire radiative power in MW. Use it for wildfires right now near a place or in a country: bbox is west,south,east,north in degrees — longitude first (Portugal ≈ -9.6,36.9,-6.1,42.2).

tools.name: get_power_plugs
tools.description: Plug types (IEC A–N), mains voltage and frequency for one country, with the source of the value, plus the campsite hook-up connector in Europe (CEE17). Use it for socket and plug types, adapters, mains voltage and campsite hook-ups.

tools.name: get_customs_rules
tools.description: Customs rules when driving into a country, optionally from a given country: food bans, cash declaration, alcohol and tobacco limits, goods value, fuel in a canister. Each rule carries a verbatim official quote and source link. A country without data returns an error saying so — never present that as

tools.name: list_license_plate_countries
tools.description: Countries whose license plates are available: international code, number of regions and an example plate.

tools.name: get_license_plate_country
tools.description: How a country's license plate looks and reads (standard, size, format), its plate types (standard, diplomatic, police, taxi…) with example numbers, and every region code on its plates, grouped by region — e.g. which region is 77 or 199 on Russian plates. Use it for what a plate region code means (77

tools.name: check_license_plate
tools.description: Validate a plate number against the country's format (look-alike letters are normalized) and say which region its code belongs to. Pass type to check against a specific plate type's format. Never identifies the owner or the vehicle's location. Use it to check a specific plate number.

tools.name: get_license_plate_image
tools.description: Draw an illustrative image of a country's standard civilian license plate (PNG shown inline, plus SVG/PNG links). The number must match the country's standard format. Official, police, military and diplomatic plates are not drawn. Use it to draw or show a picture of a plate.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_roadbook_build_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: locale, waypoints, passports, residence, kids, pets, plates, weight, vehicle_class, fuel, consumption, tank, start_date, hours_per_day, round_trip, avoid_tolls, currency, code

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_fuel_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Supports the same price keys as /api/fuel/prices, including gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list." → after: "Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Covers gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list. Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, LPG/autogas/propane or CNG in one country; without a co"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
